title: The whole package

author: oli_rae.a

title: Favourite tracking app
body: This is an easy to use, visually pleasing to look at app with almost all the features I need to record my habits and I use this to track my various health, fitness and beauty habits. It is pleasant to use so it helps you keep on track. I wish that for some of the number values on goals you could select to choose 1.5 rather than only 1 or 2 and a few small other points to make this even more the best app for tracking habits. But this is just a genuine review for this habit app, and it’s helping me keep track of my habits and glow up!!
author: Kristy163589

title: I found the "the one"!
body: I’ve tried a lot of habit tracker apps over the years and this is the one I keep coming back to. The interface is simple, clean, and actually makes me want to keep using it. It doesn’t try to do too much, which makes it easy to stay consistent. Habit tracking only works if you stick with it, and this is the first app that made that easy for me.
author: villafrm005

title: Really good habit app.
body: I’ve tried so many habit apps and this is the only one that has almost all the features I want. You can see your streak for each habit on the main page, you can set how many days a week you want to complete a habit (like every two days), it is a reasonable price for a yearly subscription, the UI is nice. I really appreciate how customisable it is and how simple it is to use. I wish that I could enter longer names for a habit, the character count is pretty short
author: Sashasct

title: Clean and powerful
body: Does all the basics well, looks good and has great statistics. The unheralded feature for me is the ability to count the number of actions completed, even if you go above your daily goal. I.e. if I have read 10 pages a day as a goal, I can set it up so I can count the exact number of pages I have read in a given day. So maybe I lose my streak, but I can see my reading habit with more detail over the course of the week, and using the “average” figure, I can see whether I’ve exceeded my goal in any given time period (I.e. if my average is above 10 during the week, I know while I might not have read 10 pages every day, over the course of the week I have hit the mark).
author: dan_lamont

title: Average but could be great
body:
I love inputting my habits, it’s rewarding to tick stuff off… 

BUT… when you want to see how you’ve been going, the statistics are quite disappointing. 
You want be able to look back over your metrics and check where you’ve done well, or not. 

IF… they made it more clear, you could track things like “oh my bad habit of drinking led me to miss the gym for the next three days”

That would be game changing!

title: Great tracking. Great Widgets.
body: Immaculate design. Best habit tracker for me as I like simple designs and colors. I wish there were more color options and more icons for specific habits available.

I love its simplicity and versatility for different types of habits and scenarios. The Apple Watch app is really intuitive and the cloud syncing is great between all my Apple devices. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a well designed, easy to use but powerful habit tracker!

author: MJGodfrey

title: Awesome Habits is hands down the best habit tracker!
body:
I’ve tried many similar apps, but Awesome Habits stands out as the best by far! It’s incredibly user-friendly and well-designed. I’ve already recommended it to many people as the top habit and streaks tracker. Some have even started using it as a general reminder app, finding it very easy to create multiple reminders for recurring tasks. It’s simple, effective, and a joy to use!

There is one feature I would love to see added. When I set multiple reminders for a habit, notifications continue even after the habit has been marked as complete. It would be great to have an option to toggle notifications on or off for a habit once it’s completed. This would make an already awesome app even better!

title: Great
body:
Loving this The only thing I wish is that you could choose to not see habits that are skipped for that day. Also if the entire habit line would turn green if done - it is hard at a glance to work out what is done and what is outstanding

I also would love a feature where if you didn’t do the habit you could mark no if you missed it / are too late and the habit go away so it’s easy to see the habits left to complete for the day

Thank you
author: Sparklebond

title: Best Input, Ordinary Visualisations
body:
This app has the greatest data input for tracking habits that I’ve ever seen in any app. It is a joy to tick off your habits in this app. The condensed input widgets are a game changer too. 

Unfortunately the data visualisation are basic at best. There are no real options for customising data views or comparing data of with interchangeable widgets or views. The lack of more visualisation options is the difference between this being an ok app and the perfect habit tracker for me. 

I’d pay for the premium version of this this app just for the input experience if there were a way to integrate the data with another service. I can see that I can download a .csv file which is nice, but without a way to automate integration with an app with better visualisations, manual csv downloads are too clunky for my needs.

title: Fabulous
body: This app is easy to set up, easy to use. I love that you can have a widget on your device to see your progress at a glance. With habit breaking or habit building, it’s great to have automated reminders and to see your progress at a glance. Love this app.

author: Tom Barclay

title: Need fix sync issue
body:
The app is excellent overall. However, I've noticed a recurring issue where updates to habit descriptions or titles often revert to previous versions. I'm unsure if this is a synchronization problem or related to iCloud. Could you please address this issue? 

Aside from that, I'm very impressed with the app's ability to record detailed descriptions and sync seamlessly between iPhone and Mac. 

Once this issue is resolved, I'll gladly give the app a 5-star rating.
author: KaiHelp10K

title: First Rate
body:
Everything about using this app has been pleasing to me.

The app interface is simple and intuitive, whilst also providing all the functions that spring to mind.  During my initial subscription month, which expired on the day I wrote this review, I emailed the developer a feature related question. He responded within hours. Twice. Outstanding support. As such, I am buying the app outright.

I think this app is well suited to the subscription model, as learning new habits might occur over only a few months. That said, I am not generally a fan of subscription models and prefer to buy. In this case the developer also seems to have put some careful thought toward the pricing structure, as it seems reasonable to me at each price point (monthly or annual subscription, or buy).

Finally, and also importantly, the app does not needlessly collect data. This is a significant positive given the fact that many others apps track you. 

So, if you want to change your habits, and are looking for a reasonably priced and simple to use app - this may be for you!

author: Astrocp

title: Beautiful. Simple. Affordable.
body:
This app has transformed the way I manage my productivity. 

I tried out a variety of habit tracking apps and found this one to be the best for my needs. It has a clean and minimal design, without the clutter of confusing functions that other apps offer. I appreciate that there is an option to do a one-time payment for the pro version, subscriptions are a deal breaker for me. Keep it that way. 

There are plenty of settings to customise and sort your habits. The widgets are integrated seamlessly. You can view a straightforward visual of your completion history. You hear a ding every time you complete a habit. This app just ticks all the boxes. 

I sent the devs feedback with a few suggestions on potential features and their prompt and thorough reply tells me that they are committed to making improvements to their app.
author: Ricky Bray

title: Fantastic app, perfect if not for limited widgets
body:
Best habit tracker i’ve ever used. I’ve tried every single one i can find and this beats them all hands down. The only downside is that widgets do not display any text. You can select a list to display as a widget but it will not show the name of the list or of the tasks in the list. This makes it difficult to tell each activity apart on the widget (when they share the same icon) or to know which list is being displayed (especially an issue when only the % circle is visible.) seeing the names of activities works as a prompt for many so i use another tracker alongside this app. otherwise: literally perfect, 11/10

asides from this frustrating

title: Great habit tracking app
body:
I’m loving Awesome Habits (have it on my Mac, phone and watch). Pretty much as soon as I started using it I could see how useful it could be, started the free Premium trial and am now a Premium subscriber. I especially love the watch app, it has easily the best UI of all the habit tracking apps I’ve tried using from my watch. The fact that it also has a Mac app and widgets for both Mac and phone is a bonus.

The one feature that I would like to see is the ability to set a unit other than 1 for count (e.g. if I have a goal to write 500 words in a day, I’d like to be able to tap once for each 100 words that I write). Even without this feature it’s pretty much a 5 star app for me.
